== Hero Usage ==

* Only [[martial]] primary professions using a [[melee]] weapon will use this skill on their own. These heroes use it at the start of combat to engage enemies.
* Heroes will not use it on their own outside combat, even if they fall behind the rest of the group.

== Notes ==
* Dash boosts speed enough to allow a [[character]] to pass through and trigger a [[trap]] without being affected.
* This skill increases average speed by 18.75% if used every time it recharges.
** Combine with [[Dwarven Stability]] for up to 6 seconds speed boost every 8 seconds and up to 37.5% average speed boost.
* Despite being linked to an [[Attribute]], this skill does not benefit from that attribute in any way.
